title: Daily price above prior SMA200 full-capital long/cash timing
thesis: A causal complete-day close above its prior-200-complete-day simple average may identify persistent BTC bull regimes slowly enough to avoid noise but early enough to preserve material upside, reduce bear-market drawdown and improve fee-adjusted Calmar over full-capital buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For each complete UTC day, compare its close strictly with the arithmetic mean of exactly the prior 200 complete-day closes, excluding the current close. Hold full BTC when above and zero-yield cash otherwise, executing a changed target at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: The long horizon is intended to stay invested through persistent advances while exiting prolonged adverse regimes. It is useful only if SMA200 retains material after-cost upside, improves drawdown and Calmar, survives annual breadth, and remains stable at rejection-only SMA150 and SMA250 neighbors.
